name: How do I choose an AEO provider for my pool contractor business?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO provider for my pool contractor business?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO provider, look for a company with a proven track record in digital marketing, specifically with local businesses or in the home services industry. Key considerations include their understanding of your local market (e.g., New York City or Chicago), their approach to content strategy, technical expertise in structured data, and clear reporting methods. Ensure they prioritize ethical practices and can demonstrate how their strategies align with your business goals for lead generation and brand visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO provider with a proven track record in local digital marketing, an understanding of your market, technical expertise, clear reporting, and ethical practices.
